stemMd: For a capacitor of fixed capacitance, doubling the voltage changes stored energy by what factor?
explanationMd: Capacitor energy is one half C V squared. With C unchanged, doubling V multiplies V squared and hence the energy by four.

distractorRationale.c: Charge doubles, but energy is quadratic in voltage.
